android.desc:
HackerFlow is a native mobile app for exploring Hacker News, following discussions, and saving the stories and comments you care about.

Browse the latest stories from the Hacker News community in a clean, focused interface. Open discussions, read comment threads, share interesting stories, and stay connected to what people are talking about.

Save useful stories and comments into custom bookmark lists so you can return to them later. Organize bookmarks by project, topic, idea, or anything else that fits how you read.

HackerFlow also helps you stay involved. Submit new stories, preview posts before submitting, and reply directly to stories or comments while reading discussions.

Need to find something again? Your reading history makes it easy to return to stories you opened earlier, whether you want the article, the discussion, or both.

You can also view and manage your Hacker News profile, check your karma, and browse your submissions and comments.

Key features:

Browse the latest Hacker News stories
Read active discussion threads
Share stories with others
Bookmark stories and comments
Organize bookmarks into custom lists
Submit new stories
Preview posts before submitting
Reply to stories and comments
Revisit recently opened stories
View your Hacker News profile, karma, submissions, and comments
HackerFlow is built for readers who want a focused, practical Hacker News experience on mobile.

quotes.text:
I'm working on a feature rich native Hacker News app. I tried out all HN Reader on the App Store but sadly they either have to few useful features, bad UI or both so I decided to build one myself. Currenlty I have an Android version in the Play Store and I am working on an the iOS verison.

Aside form an improved UI the app has a history so that you never loose a story and advanced bookmarking for saving stories and comments into custom folders.

It is still ruff arround the edges, for example I shipped it with login for upvoting stories and writing comments but the feature broke some time ago and I didnt have time to fix it yet, especially that I noticed most users don't even log in in the first place.

If you have an Android phone and love hacker news give it a Try:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.hackerflow
